## About
Dr. Christina Brasher has always had a passion for taking care of others. She worked as a physical therapy technician and later as an Exercise Specialist in the Cardiac Rehab program at Arlington Memorial Hospital before debilitating migraines and a chance visit to a local chiropractor changed her life.
Chiropractic reduced the pain and frequency of her migraines, and it showed her that care can be about whole body wellness, natural and drug free. She went back to school at Parker University to become a chiropractor so she could help others. In her words: "There are too many people out there suffering. I want them to know - There is help and there is hope."
Today she sees patients at our office on Egypt Ln in Magnolia, and our patients have given us a 5 rating from 54 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic Care: Gentle adjustments for the whole family, with a focus on whole body wellness and pain relief.
- Prenatal Chiropractic Care - Webster Technique certified: Care through pregnancy and postpartum. A reviewer who came in with pelvic and back pain during pregnancy said it was such a relief.
- Pediatric Chiropractic Care: Gentle, patient care for babies and children.
- Myofascial Release: Dr. Brasher is Fascial Distortion Method (FDM) certified.
- Therapeutic Exercises

## FAQ
Q: Do you see babies and children?
A: Yes. Pediatric care is one of our specialties. A parent wrote that Dr. Brasher began seeing her son when he was just 1 month old, and now cares for their entire family.

Q: Can you help during pregnancy?
A: Yes. Dr. Brasher offers prenatal chiropractic care and is Webster Technique certified.

Q: Is chiropractic care drug free?
A: Yes. Dr. Brasher chose chiropractic because it is a natural, holistic approach to health.

Q: How do you schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call, or leave your information on our contact form and we will get back to you shortly.
